name: Brie and Cranberry Pastry Wreath
subtitle: A festive ring of flaky pastry with creamy cheese and cranberry
description: Shape puff pastry around a cranberry, brie, and hazelnut filling, then bake until golden and set.

ingredients.item: micro herbs or salad leaves to serve (optional)

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to the temperature required for the pastry, and line a baking tray.
Dust the work surface with flour and roll the pastry into a large round. Transfer it to the tray and mark a smaller circle in the center without cutting through.
Cut the outer pastry into evenly spaced strips, then cut the inner circle into wedges to create sections for folding.
Stir the cranberry sauce and spread it around the pastry ring. Cut the brie into thick pieces and arrange them over the sauce; scatter with the chopped hazelnuts.
Fold the pastry sections over the filling and press the edges to seal. Brush with beaten egg, make small cuts as needed for definition, and sprinkle with the dried herbs.
Bake for 25 minutes, until the pastry is golden brown and the center reaches 160°F on a food thermometer.
Cool for 10 minutes, then serve with the micro herbs or salad leaves if using.
